title: Hovering a name in a dashboard chart legend shows the latest value and month
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two) have clocked time at {Location-A} in the last twelve months, so both are listed in the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization chart legends on Last 12 Months.
  • Service advisors {Advisor-A} and {Advisor-B} (for example Admin ShopView and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Two) have invoiced work with clocked time at {Location-A} in the last twelve months, so both are listed in the Billing Efficiency chart legend on Last 12 Months.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Billing Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months and click View details on Billing Efficiency.
  3. Hover {Advisor-A}'s name in the legend above the chart.
  4. Read the box that appears.
  5. Hover {Advisor-A}'s last point on the chart and read its value and month.
  6. Set the Technician Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months, click View details on Technician Efficiency and hover {Technician-A}'s name in the legend.
  7. Set the Technician Utilization pill to Last 12 Months, click View details on Technician Utilization and hover {Technician-A}'s name in the legend.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The box shows {Advisor-A}'s name, their most recent value and the month it is from (for example 120% and Aug 2026).
  • Step 4: The box shows no average: no "avg" figure and no other figure for the whole range anywhere in it.
  • Steps 4 and 5: The value and the month in the box match the last point on {Advisor-A}'s line (for example both read 120% for Aug 2026).
  • Steps 6 and 7: On the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts the box shows {Technician-A}'s most recent value and its month, with no average.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S9-R10 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 12 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14) and S9-R4; read 14 Oct 2026. The design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge) boards 05_Billing_Legend, 06_TechEff_Legend and 07_TechUtil_Legend show an average in the box; PRD version 45 (14 Oct 2026) says the box shows no average, and we take the later PRD as prevailing. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version was last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R10: “Hovering a name in a chart legend shows that person's most recent value and the month it is from, for example "120% · Aug 2026". It shows no average; the table beside the chart gives the figure for the whole range.”
  • S9-R4: “The Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
